characters.name: Toon Link
characters.description: Small boy hero with large expressive eyes, blonde hair, pointed ears. At the start of the book he wears his ordinary Outset Island clothes: a blue shirt and orange shorts, bare feet or simple sandals — the outfit of a normal island kid. Mid-book he receives the green hero's tunic and cap (long green tunic, green pointed cap, brown boots, brown belt) as a birthday gift from his grandmother, and wears it for the rest of the story. Same boy, same face — only the clothes change.
characters.source: Toon Link from The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker

characters.name: Aryll
characters.description: Link's little sister, about 6 years old. Small, cheerful, blonde pigtails, big round cheeks, bright eyes. Wears a pink summer dress with a red-orange skull motif and a round sunhat-type headpiece. Carries a red-rimmed telescope. Sweet, bouncy, affectionate — she adores her big brother.
characters.source: Aryll from The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker

characters.name: Grandma
characters.description: Link's grandmother — a small, hunched, kind old woman with white hair and a warm, deeply lined face. Wears a simple long dress and apron. Moves slowly but carefully. Her love for the children shows in every gesture.
characters.source: Link's Grandma from The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker

characters.name: Tetra
characters.description: A tough pirate girl about Link's age. Tan skin, messy dirty-blonde hair pulled back in a short ponytail, bright blue eyes with a sharp look. Wears a blue vest over a white shirt, rolled-up brown trousers, a red bandana at her waist, a gold bracelet. Scrappy, confident, brusque — not a girly-girl. Bossy but not cruel.
characters.source: Tetra from The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker

characters.name: Great Bird
characters.description: An enormous, terrifying bird — the Helmaroc King. Huge wingspan, dark feathers, a fearsome beaked mask-face, sharp talons. Too big to be natural. When it flies overhead its shadow covers everything. Called 'Avis Magna' in the Latin — 'the great bird.' A looming menace, not a character we get to know.
characters.source: Helmaroc King from The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker

characters.name: Monsters
characters.description: Small forest monsters (Bokoblins from Wind Waker). Short, hunched, purple-gray skin, beady yellow eyes, tusks, wearing ragged loincloths, carrying crude clubs or sticks. Ugly but more pathetic than terrifying — easy for Link to drive off with a sword. Called 'monstra' in the Latin.
characters.source: Bokoblins from The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker

characters.name: Orca
characters.description: An old wiry swordmaster with long white hair and long white beard, bare-chested, purple pants with red sash. Wields a long spear. Stern but kind. Lives on Outset and teaches sword skills.
characters.source: Orca from The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker

locations.name: Outset Island - Morning
locations.description: A small, bright tropical island at dawn. Warm golden light on green grass, palm trees, thatched cottages on stilts, a wooden watchtower. Blue ocean surrounds everything. Safe, familiar, home. Wind Waker cel-shaded style.

locations.name: Outset Island - Aryll's Lookout
locations.description: A tall, narrow wooden watchtower on the eastern beach of Outset Island, with a vertical ladder running up one side and a small platform with railing at the top. The structure stands on stilts in the sand. Seagulls circle around it. Ocean visible directly behind, palm trees nearby. Link likes to sleep up here at night.

locations.name: Outset Island - Suspension Bridge
locations.description: A long narrow wooden plank-and-rope suspension bridge spanning a deep chasm between the eastern village cliff and the western Forest of Fairies cliff. Frayed ropes, planks of varying lengths, drops to surf-pounded rocks below. Wind catches the bridge.

locations.name: Grandma's Cottage Interior
locations.description: The cozy inside of Link's grandmother's small cottage. Wooden walls, a low table, a small fireplace or hearth, a ladder up to the sleeping loft. Warm amber light from a window. A few simple wooden bowls, a broom in the corner, dried herbs hanging from beams. Lived-in and loving.

locations.name: Outset Island - Cliff Lookout
locations.description: The high lookout point on Outset Island — a grassy cliff edge overlooking the wide blue ocean. A single twisted tree. The watchtower of the village visible behind. Wind moves the grass. Endless horizon of sea and sky. This is where you go to watch the world.

locations.name: Outset Island - Forest
locations.description: A small dense patch of tropical forest on the island interior. Thick palm fronds, tangled vines, broken fallen logs, dappled green-gold sunlight filtering through the canopy. Shadows between the trees. Slightly wild, slightly dangerous — the opposite of the tidy village.

locations.name: Outset Island - Beach
locations.description: The sandy beach of Outset Island. Pale warm sand, gentle waves lapping, a wooden dock. A small pirate ship anchored just offshore — sails furled, hull weathered, a skull-and-crossbones flag. Palm trees at the edge of the sand. Where the island meets the sea.

locations.name: Open Ocean
locations.description: The wide open sea just off Outset Island. Deep blue water, sparkling sun on waves, a few wispy clouds. The pirate ship under sail. In the distance: the silhouette of Outset Island shrinking behind. Vast, uncertain, the unknown.

pages.english_text: It was morning on Outset Island.
pages.scene_description: Wide establishing shot of Outset Island at dawn. Warm golden sunrise light floods across the green grass and the thatched cottages on stilts. The ocean sparkles. A few gulls drift above. The island looks completely peaceful — no humans visible yet. A quiet, safe, beautiful morning. Wind Waker cel-shaded style.

pages.english_text: Link was asleep on the lookout.
pages.scene_description: Top of Aryll's Lookout — a wooden watchtower platform on the eastern beach of Outset Island. Link is curled up asleep on the wooden platform, head on his arm, wearing his blue Outset Island shirt with red lobster embroidery and orange shorts. Bare feet. Sleeping peacefully under the open sky. Soft dawn light, gulls drifting above, ocean stretching out behind him. He fell asleep up here last night.

pages.english_text: Aryll climbed up. "Brother! Brother!"
pages.scene_description: Aryll has just climbed up the wooden ladder of the watchtower and is poking her head over the platform edge, both hands on the platform, pigtails bouncing. She is grinning hugely, calling Link to wake up. Link starts awake, sitting up, eyes wide. Bright morning sky behind them, ocean below. Link still in his blue Outset shirt and orange shorts. First appearance of refrain 'Soror mea!' as Link's affectionate groan.

pages.english_text: "Today is your birthday!"
pages.scene_description: Both Link and Aryll now sit on top of the watchtower platform together. Aryll has thrown her arms around Link's shoulders, beaming. Link's still rubbing the sleep from one eye but a smile is spreading. Sun coming up over the ocean horizon behind them, soft golden rays. Link still in blue shirt and orange shorts.

pages.english_text: Grandma smiled. She had a gift.
pages.scene_description: Grandma stands in the main room of the cottage by the low table, hunched and warm-faced, her white hair tied back. She holds out with both hands a neatly folded bundle of bright green cloth with a pointed green cap on top and small brown boots beside it on the table. THE HERO'S TUNIC, folded and offered. Her face is soft, nostalgic, proud. Link stands before her in his blue shirt and orange shorts, staring at the green cloth with huge eyes — amazed. Aryll peeks from behind him, hands clasped to her mouth. The gift is visually central.

pages.english_text: Link put on the green clothes. He was like a hero.
pages.scene_description: THE TRANSFORMATION PAGE. Link now stands in the middle of the cottage wearing the full green hero's tunic, green pointed cap, brown belt, brown boots — exactly the iconic outfit. Arms slightly spread, looking down at himself, a grin spreading across his face. Aryll jumps in delight beside him, pigtails flying. Grandma watches from the side, one hand over her heart. The light on Link is warm and slightly golden — he looks transformed. From this page forward, Link wears the green tunic.

pages.english_text: Aryll waited at the lookout. She had a gift!
pages.scene_description: Link, now in his green hero tunic and cap, climbs back up the ladder of the watchtower. Aryll waits at the top, holding out with both hands her treasured red telescope. Her smile is bright but a little brave — she loves this telescope, she's giving it anyway. The morning light is full now. Tender sibling moment.

pages.english_text: Link looked through the telescope. He saw the sea.
pages.scene_description: On top of the watchtower, Link holds Aryll's red telescope up to one eye with both hands, leaning forward. Aryll stands beside him, also looking out. Wind catches Link's green cap. The vast blue ocean spreads out below them, the morning sun sparkling on the waves. Excitement, possibility.

pages.english_text: A great bird! It carried a girl!
pages.scene_description: Through-the-telescope view or split focus: the sky over the distant ocean, and in it an ENORMOUS dark bird — the Helmaroc King — wings spread, masked face, huge talons clutching a small struggling girl (Tetra, visible but small). The bird is terrifying and huge. Tiny in the foreground corner we see Link's shocked face, telescope still at his eye, mouth open in alarm. The peace has just cracked. Dark shape against bright sky.

pages.english_text: The bird dropped the girl. Into the forest!
pages.scene_description: Mid-air action shot. The huge dark bird is banking away with empty talons, wings beating. Tetra falls through the air, arms flailing, ponytail streaming, falling toward the canopy of the island forest below. Her mouth open in a yell. The forest trees rise up to catch her. Visible in the corner: the distant cliff where tiny Link still stands watching, telescope lowered now, body tensed. Drama and motion.

pages.english_text: Link ran to Orca's house. "I need a sword!"
pages.scene_description: Link bursts into Orca's house. Orca, the old swordmaster with long white hair and beard, stands holding his spear. Link points toward the forest desperately, asking for a sword. Orca's eyes narrow with understanding. Indoor scene, wooden walls.

pages.english_text: Orca gave him a sword. Link ran into the forest.
pages.scene_description: Orca hands Link a small sword with a solemn expression. Link accepts it with both hands, determined. Outside Orca's doorway, Link now dashes toward the forest holding the sword. Split scene or sequential.

pages.english_text: Tetra lay on the ground. Monsters came near!
pages.scene_description: In the forest clearing. Tetra lies unconscious on the forest floor. Two Bokoblin monsters (small gray goblin creatures) creep toward her with weapons raised. Dark tangled forest around them.

pages.english_text: Link attacked the monsters. He defeated them!
pages.scene_description: Link in his green hero tunic charges into the clearing, sword raised, attacking. Focus on motion lines and the Bokoblins falling backward — NOT the moment of impact, NOT blood. The monsters are shown being defeated/vanishing in a puff as the sword swings past them. Dynamic action but family-friendly.

pages.english_text: Aryll waited at the bridge. Then — a great shadow!
pages.scene_description: On the wooden suspension bridge between the village cliff and the Forest of Fairies cliff. Link and Tetra are walking back across the bridge from the forest. On the village side at the end of the bridge, Aryll stands waving happily at her brother — pink dress, pigtails, big smile. But suddenly an enormous DARK SHADOW falls across the bridge — Link and Tetra look up in alarm. The huge silhouette of the Helmaroc King swoops in from above the cliffs.

pages.english_text: The bird grabbed Aryll! "My sister!"
pages.scene_description: EMOTIONAL LOW POINT. The huge dark Helmaroc King has swooped down over the bridge area and clutched Aryll in its talons — she is being lifted into the air over the chasm, her pink dress flailing, sunhat flying off, little arms reaching back. Her mouth wide open in a scream. Link stands at the village end of the bridge, has dropped his sword, both arms outstretched toward her, face transformed with horror. Second appearance of refrain 'Soror mea!' — anguish. Tetra runs onto the bridge behind Link.

pages.english_text: Link ran. But he could not reach her.
pages.scene_description: Link sprints to the very edge of the cliff at the end of the suspension bridge, almost tumbling off — Tetra catches his arm just in time, holding him back from the drop. Link's other hand still reaches toward the sky. The bird is already a small dark shape carrying tiny pink Aryll out over the open ocean. Link's face devastated. The smallness of him against the vastness of the sea.

pages.english_text: "Take me with you! My sister!"
pages.scene_description: The beach now. Tetra stands on the wooden dock, half-turned, one foot already raised to step toward her pirate ship anchored offshore. Link has run after her and grabbed her sleeve with one hand — his other hand points out over the water in the direction the bird flew. His face is streaked with tears but his jaw is set — he is not just begging, he is demanding. Third and final appearance of the refrain 'Soror mea!' — now transformed from joy (p.3) through terror (p.16) to pure resolve. Tetra turns to look at him, her sharp eyes narrowing — considering.

pages.english_text: Tetra nodded. "Come aboard."
pages.scene_description: Tetra stands on the deck of the pirate ship now, one hand on the rail, head tilted, and gives Link a single brusque nod — not warm, but not cruel. A businesslike yes. Link stands at the foot of the gangplank, small sword still in his hand, green tunic a little dirty, looking up at her. Grandma has appeared at the edge of the beach in the background — we can see her small figure with one hand pressed to her mouth, watching her grandson preparing to sail away. The wind is picking up. The ship's sails are being unfurled.

pages.english_text: The ship sailed away. Link looked back.
pages.scene_description: FINAL IMAGE. The pirate ship under full sail on the open ocean, cutting through blue water. Outset Island is already receding in the distance — small and green behind them. Link stands at the back of the ship, both hands on the rail, looking back at the shrinking island. On the distant beach, tiny but visible: Grandma, still standing where they left her, one hand raised in a small wave. Link's face is not crying now — it is set, older somehow. Sad but going. The wind in his green cap. One boy, one sister out there somewhere, one long journey beginning. END.
